evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies FlushStateToDisk in src/validation.cpp.
rationale: This fixes a crash-safety and chainstate integrity flaw where metadata and coins database updates continued writing after block or undo file flushes failed. When FlushChainstateBlockFile() failed, FlushStateToDisk() still wrote block-index metadata and advanced m_last_flushed_block, which reviewer mzumsande noted can cause actual disk corruption if a separate -blocksdir fsync fails permanently.
